events.headline: Anthropic launches roadshow for proposed IPO
events.summary: The IPO is for 825,000,000 Class A shares: 801,351,354 sold by Anthropic and 23,648,646 by existing stockholders. The expected price range is $70–$78 per share, with a 30-day underwriter option for up to 123,750,000 more shares. Anthropic has applied to list on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the ticker ANT.

events.headline: Introducing Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2
events.summary: Anthropic released two new models, Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2. The details come from search results and were not checked on the launch page: Mythos 5.2 has restricted access, and both have 1M-token context and adaptive thinking.

events.headline: AI for Science expands to foundations and research institutions
events.summary: Anthropic expanded its AI for Science program to more foundations and research institutions. Search results say it now covers 20 organizations; this was not checked on the post.

events.headline: Expanded partnership with GSA to bring Claude to all levels of government
events.summary: Anthropic expanded its partnership with the US General Services Administration (GSA) to bring Claude to all levels of government.

events.headline: Anthropic files S-1 with the SEC for proposed IPO
events.summary: Anthropic, PBC filed a public Form S-1 for an IPO of Class A common stock, planning to list on Nasdaq Global Select as ANT. Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley are named as contacts for the preliminary prospectus. The share count and price were not set at filing.

events.headline: Anthropic donates Agent Skills to the Agentic AI Foundation
events.summary: Anthropic donated its Agent Skills to the Agentic AI Foundation.

events.headline: Physicist Christopher Stubbs joins Anthropic's Long-Term Benefit Trust
events.summary: Christopher Stubbs was appointed to Anthropic's Long-Term Benefit Trust.

events.headline: Anthropic commits 5% of shares to new Anthropic Public Benefit Fund
events.summary: Anthropic committed 5% of its shares to a new Anthropic Public Benefit Fund, subject to stockholder approval. The board may add 2% more for every 50% rise in company value above a set baseline.

events.headline: Anthropic opens Singapore office and signs MOU with Government of Singapore
events.summary: Singapore is Anthropic's fifth Asia-Pacific office. Anthropic also signed an MOU with Singapore's Ministry of Digital Development and Information covering AI safety, security, model evaluation and adoption.

events.headline: Introducing the Anthropic Cyber Mission
events.summary: Anthropic launched the Anthropic Cyber Mission, a long-term commitment to cybersecurity. It also published a 2026 Usage Policy update the same day.

events.headline: Anthropic builds on its commitment to American scientific discovery (Genesis Mission)
events.summary: Anthropic made a new commitment to the federal Genesis Mission. Search results say it is $150M over three years; this was not checked on the post.

events.headline: Introducing Claude Haiku 5.5
events.summary: Anthropic released Claude Haiku 5.5, its new small model.

events.headline: Expanding the Cyber Verification Program
events.summary: Anthropic expanded its Cyber Verification Program.

events.headline: Anthropic invests $100 million to train 10,000 engineers (Claude Frontier Academy)
events.summary: Anthropic committed $100M to train 10,000 engineers to address the enterprise AI talent gap.

events.headline: Introducing Claude Opus 5.5
events.summary: Anthropic released Claude Opus 5.5, its flagship model.
